===The Golems===
'''Items required:''' ''Ancestral key'', ''Robes of Elidinis'', ''Rope, Pickaxe, ranged weapon and ammo OR runes for magic, crush, slash and stab weapon.''
{{Map|3371,3132|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|width=220|height=220|caption=The location of the waterfall on the map.}}
[[File:Water Ravine Dungeon entrance.png|thumb|The waterfall.]]
{{Checklist|
*Follow the river north until you reach a dungeon's cave opening with a waterfall coming out of it. (Alternatively: [[Necklace of passage]] Eagle's Eyrie teleport and '''go south-west''')
**Alternatively, take the carpet ride ride back to Shantay Pass, head east, cross the bridge, and follow the River Elid north to the red exclamation point.
**Pluck a [[Phoenix feather]] from a [[desert phoenix]] for a medium task in the [[Desert Diary]]. It is also used in [[The Golem]].
*'''''(You can find bronze arrows and a bronze pickaxe south of the cave entrance and a shortbow to the east)'''''
*Use your rope on the root which overhangs the cave.
*Equip the [[Robe of elidinis (top)|robes of elidinis]] and use the ancestral key on the door.
**'''Note:''' If the door will not open, make sure you have '''both''' the robes on also you may have to talk to Ghaslor the Elder and attempt to open it again afterward.
*Head east to the three doors.
*Kill the [[white golem]] to the south which is weak to [[Stab weapons|stab]].
*Enter the room and clear the water channel via [[Thieving]].
*Kill the [[Grey golem]] to the east which is weak to [[Slash weapons|slash]].
*Enter the room and clear the water channel with a [[pickaxe]].
*Kill the [[Black golem]] to the north-east which is weak to [[Crush weapons|crush]].
*Enter the room and clear the water channel by attacking the target on the other side with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] (37 ranged required even if using Magic).
*Go through the north door and talk to one of the spirits. {{Chat option|4I come as an emissary from the people of Nardah.|1Is there anything they can do to get their fountain working again?}}
*Head back to Nardah.}}
*:'''Note:''' It is possible to be bugged when exiting the cave. To get out of the bug, simply use the [[Home teleport]] spell
